answer: Stop sybils with a comet census, a saffron toll, and a sonnet chain. Each epoch a comet beacon names a random audit slice, and every identity inside it must present a sonnet: a sequential chain of attestations where each line hashes the last, salted by its own address, so one chain cannot be copied or run in parallel. Influence is priced in saffron: the k-th bond from one funder costs k squared, so N clones pay roughly N cubed for one shared slice. A sonnet line reused by two identities voids both at once.
